## Account Performance

<a id="opIdgetSinglePerformancePeriod"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.ibkr.com/v1/api/pa/performance \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "acctIds": [],
    "period": "12M"
  }'
```

`POST /v1/api/pa/performance`

Returns the performance (MTM) for the given accounts, if more than one account is passed, the result is consolidated.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "acctIds": [],
  "period": "12M"
}
```

<h3 id="account-performance-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» acctIds|body|array|false|An array of strings containing each account identifier to retrieve performance details for.|
|» period|body|string|false|Specify the period for which the account should be analyzed. Available period lengths:<br>  * `1D` - The last 24 hours.<br>  * `7D` - The last 7 full days.<br>  * `MTD` - Performance since the 1st of the month.<br>  * `1M` - A full calendar month from the last full trade day.<br>  * `3M` - 3 full calendar months from the last full trade day.<br>  * `6M` - 6 full calendar months from the last full trade day.<br>  * `12M` - 12 full calendar month from the last full trade day.<br>  * `YTD` - Performance since January 1st.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» period|1D|
|» period|7D|
|» period|MTD|
|» period|1M|
|» period|3M|
|» period|6M|
|» period|12M|
|» period|YTD|

## Transaction History

```bash
curl https://api.ibkr.com/v1/api/pa/transactions \
```

`POST /v1/api/pa/transactions`

Transaction history for a given number of conids and accounts. Types of transactions include dividend payments, buy and sell transactions, transfers.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "acctIds": [
    "DU123456"
  ],
  "conids": [
    265598
  ],
  "currency": "USD",
  "days": 90
}
```

|body|body|object|true|none|

|» conids|body|[integer(int64)]|false|none|
|» currency|body|string|false|Define the currency to display price amounts with.|
|» days|body|integer(int64)|false|Specify the number of days to receive transaction data for.|

<h1 id="ib-rest-api-trading-scanner">Trading Scanner</h1>

## Run An IServer Market Scanner

<a id="opIdgetScannerResults"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.ibkr.com/v1/api/iserver/scanner/run \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "instrument": "STK",
    "location": "STK.US.MAJOR",
    "type": "TOP_TRADE_COUNT",
    "filter": [
      {
        "code": "priceAbove",
        "value": 5
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v1/api/iserver/scanner/run`

Searches for contracts according to the filters specified in /iserver/scanner/params endpoint.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "instrument": "STK",
  "location": "STK.US.MAJOR",
  "type": "TOP_TRADE_COUNT",
  "filter": [
    {
      "code": "priceAbove",
      "value": 5
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="run-an-iserver-market-scanner-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[iserverScannerRunRequest](#schemaiserverscannerrunrequest)|true|none|
|» instrument|body|string|false|Instrument type as the target of the market scanner request. Found in the "instrument_list" section of the /iserver/scanner/params response.|
|» type|body|string|false|Scanner value the market scanner is sorted by. Based on the "scan_type_list" section of the /iserver/scanner/params response.|
|» location|body|string|false|Location value the market scanner is searching through. Based on the "location_tree" section of the /iserver/scanner/params response.|
|» filter|body|[object]|false|Contains any additional filters that should apply to response.|
|» » code|body|string|false|Code value of the filter. Based on the "code" value within the "filter_list" section of the /iserver/scanner/params response.|
|» » value|body|string \| integer(int64) \| boolean \| number|false|Value corresponding to the input for "code".|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|integer(int64)|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|boolean|false|none|
|» » » *oneOf*|body|number|false|none|

> Example responses

```json
}
```

## Initialize Brokerage Session

<a id="opIdinitializeSession"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.ibkr.com/v1/api/iserver/auth/ssodh/init \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "publish": true,
    "compete": true
  }'
```

`POST /v1/api/iserver/auth/ssodh/init`

After retrieving the access token and subsequent Live Session Token, customers can initialize their brokerage session with the ssodh/init endpoint.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "publish": true,
  "compete": true
}
```

<h3 id="initialize-brokerage-session-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[brokerageSessionInitRequest](#schemabrokeragesessioninitrequest)|true|none|
|» publish|body|boolean|false|publish brokerage session token at the same time when brokerage session initialized. If set false, then session token should be published before calling init. Setting true is preferred way.|
|» compete|body|boolean|false|Determines if other brokerage sessions should be disconnected to prioritize this connection.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": {
    "value": {
      "authenticated": true,
      "established": true,
      "competing": false,
      "connected": true,
      "message": "",
      "MAC": "98:F2:B3:23:BF:A0",
      "serverInfo": {
        "serverName": "JifN19053",
        "serverVersion": "Build 10.25.0p, Dec 5, 2023 5:48:12 PM"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "error": "Unauthorized",
  "statusCode": 401
}
```

```json
  "error": "string"
}
```

```json

  "error": "string",
  "statusCode": 0
}
```

## Brokerage Keep-Alive Ping

<a id="opIdgetSessionToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.ibkr.com/v1/api/tickle \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /v1/api/tickle`

If the gateway has not received any requests for several minutes an open session will automatically timeout. The tickle endpoint pings the server to prevent the session from ending. It is expected to call this endpoint approximately every 60 seconds to maintain the connection to the brokerage session.

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "success": {
    "value": {
      "session": "bb665d0f55b6289d70bc7380089fc96f",
      "ssoExpires": 460311,
      "collission": false,
      "userId": 123456789,
      "hmds": {
        "error": "no bridge"
      },
      "iserver": {
        "authStatus": {
          "authenticated": true,
          "established": true,
          "competing": false,
          "connected": true,
          "message": "",
          "MAC": "98:F2:B3:23:BF:A0",
          "serverInfo": {
            "serverName": "JifN19053",
            "serverVersion": "Build 10.25.0p, Dec 5, 2023 5:48:12 PM"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "fail": {
    "value": {
      "error": "failed to process request"
    }
  }
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "error": "Unauthorized",
  "statusCode": 401
}
```

<h3 id="brokerage-keep-alive-ping-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|An array of objects detailing contract information.|[tickleResponse](#schematickleresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|Missing, invalid, or unparseable Authorization token.|[ErrorResponse](#schemaerrorresponse)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
ssoBearer
</aside>

## Create A Watchlist

```bash
curl https://api.ibkr.com/v1/api/iserver/watchlist \

}
```

```json
}
```

```bash
curl https://api.ibkr.com/gw/api/v1/echo/signed-jwt \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/jwt' \

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{"iss":"prodtester"}'
```

`POST /gw/api/v1/echo/signed-jwt`

<br>**Scope**: `echo.write`<br>**Security Policy**: `Signed JWT`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "iss": "prodtester"
}
```

<h3 id="echo-a-request-with-signed-jwt-security-policy-back-after-validation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SignedJwtEchoRequest](#schemasignedjwtechorequest)|true|Create a Signed JWT echo request.|
|» iss|body|string|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "requestMethod": "GET",
  "securityPolicy": "HTTPS",
  "queryParameters": {}
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "type": "/simple",
  "title": "Unauthorized",
  "status": 401,
  "detail": "The access token request is invalid"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "type": "/simple",
  "title": "Forbidden",
  "status": 403,
  "detail": "The access token fails to have sufficient scope"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "type": "/simple",
  "title": "Internal Server Error",
  "status": 500
}
```

<h3 id="echo-a-request-with-signed-jwt-security-policy-back-after-validation-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returns a JSON object containing the request parameters.|[EchoResponse](#schemaechoresponse)|
|401|Unauthorized|Returns a Problem detail instance representing an unauthorized request.|[InvalidAccessTokenResponse](#schemainvalidaccesstokenresponse)|
|403|Forbidden|Returns a Problem detail instance representing a forbidden request.|[InsufficientScopeResponse](#schemainsufficientscoperesponse)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Returns a Problem detail instance representing an internal server error.|[InternalServerErrorResponse](#schemainternalservererrorresponse)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
oauth2Bearer
</aside>

<h2 id="tocS_AcatsPositionV2">AcatsPositionV2</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaacatspositionv2"></a>
<a id="schema_AcatsPositionV2"></a>
<a id="tocSacatspositionv2"></a>
<a id="tocsacatspositionv2"></a>

```json
{
  "conid": 459200101,
  "quantity": 1000,
  "type": "LONG",
  "transferAll": true
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|quantity|number|false|none|Send as a positive figure. A SHORT position is recorded as a negative quantity. Omit when transferAll is true, as the whole holding is transferred; otherwise required.|
|type|string|false|none|Mandatory for ACATS and ATON, optional for other transfer methods.|
|transferAll|boolean|false|none|Transfer the whole holding of this security. Optional, defaults to false.|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|conid|number|true|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|
|tradingInstrumentDescription|object|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|LONG|
|type|SHORT|

```json
    "safeKeepingAccountId": "123456"
  }
}
```

Request to transfer positions to or from a contra broker (Basic FOP / complex asset transfer, v2). Basic FOP (Free of Payment) transfers assets from financial institutions generally outside the US (equities, fixed income, structured products, options); IBKR coordinates settlement instructions with the institution.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|clientInstructionId|number|true|none|Client-assigned identifier for this instruction; must be a positive number and unique within the request.|
|direction|string|true|none|Direction of the transfer (IN or OUT).|
|accountId|string|true|none|Interactive Brokers account identifier the instruction applies to (e.g. "U46377").|
|accountIdAtCurrentBroker|string|false|none|Client's account identifier at the current (contra) broker.|
|quantity|number|true|none|Quantity of the instrument.|
|tradingInstrument|[TradingInstrumentRef](#schematradinginstrumentref)|true|none|Identifies a security by contract id or by security id and asset type.|
|contraBrokerInfo|[ContraBrokerInfoRef](#schemacontrabrokerinforef)|true|none|Details of the contra (external) broker for the transfer.|
|nonDisclosedDetail|[NonDisclosedDetailRef](#schemanondiscloseddetailref)|false|none|Non-disclosed settlement details for the transfer.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|IN|
|direction|OUT|

<a id="tocSenumerationtype"></a>
<a id="tocsenumerationtype"></a>

```json
"exchange-bundles"
```

<ul><li>exchange-bundles - query most up to date list of exchange-bundles for tradingPermissions</li><li>business-and-occupation - list of occupation and employerBusiness for employmentDetails</li><li>employee-track - query most up to date companyId for account. For affiliation details, if company has an existing IBKR Employee Track account</li><li>fin-info-ranges - query most up to date range IDs by currency for annualNetIncome, netWorth, liquidNetWorth</li><li>acats - query most up to date values for brokerId and brokerName. Used if funding via US ACATS extPositionsTransfers</li><li>aton - query most up to date values for brokerId and brokerName. Used if funding via US ACATS extPositionsTransfers</li><li>market-data - query most up to date values for brokerId and brokerName. Used if funding via ATON Canada extPositionsTransfers</li><li>edd-avt - query questions associated with EDD (Enhanced Due Diligence) or AVT (Additional Verification) tasks assigned to an account</li><li>prohibited-country - view list of prohibited countries. Applicants that reside in prohibited country are restricted from opening an account with IBKR. Error will be thrown IF legalResidenceCountry, OR country (included within Residence, mailingAddress and employerAddress, taxResidency node) is a prohibited country</li><li>employee-plans - view EPA that are linked to master account (applicable IF offering SEP IRA accounts)</li><li>questionnaires - obtain list of questionnaires</li><li>security-questions - obtain list of questions supported for IBKR security questions</li><li>quiz-questions - obtain list of questions associated with IBKR knowledge assessment</li><li>wire-instructions - obtain list of wire instructions</li><li>product-country-bundles - obtain list of product country bundles</li><li>countries - obtain list of countries</li><li>states - obtain list of states</li><li>identification - obtain catalog of required ID documents by country (including MiFIR rules). Pass type=mifir and one or more citizenship params to instead obtain the MiFIR-required ID document(s) for the given citizenship(s)</li></ul>

### Properties

|brokerName|string|true|none|Name of the external broker; must exactly match a value from the GET participating brokers API.|
|accountAtBroker|string|true|none|Client's account number at the external broker.|
|sourceIRAType|string|false|none|Source IRA type code.|
|accountId|string|true|none|Interactive Brokers account identifier the instruction applies to (e.g. "U46377").|
|signature|string|true|none|Client signature authorizing the instruction. Expected to input the account title at IBKR.|

|passport|string|false|none|Passport|

|medicareReference|string|false|none|Required if MedicareCard is provided.|
|nationalCard|string|false|none|National Identification Card<br>Pattern by Country-<br> ARG: ^\d{8}$<br>AUS: ^(\d{8}\|\d{9})$<br>BRA: ^\d{11}$<br>CHN: ^\d{17}(\d\|X)$<br>DNK: ^\d{10}$<br>ESP: ^\d{8}[A-Z]$<br>FRA: ^\d{15}$<br>FRA: ^\d{4}([A-Z]\|\d){3}\d{5}$<br>ITA: ^([A-Z]{2}\d{7}\|\d{7}[A-Z]{2}\|[A-Z]{2}\d{5}[A-Z]{2})$<br>ITA: ^[A-Z]{6}\d{2}[A-Z]\d{2}[A-Z]\d{3}[A-Z]$<br>MEX: ^[A-Z]{4}\d{6}[A-Z]{6}\d{2}$<br>MYZ: ^\d{12}$<br>RUS: ^\d{10}$<br>RUS: ^\d{9}$<br>SGP: ^[A-Z]\d{7}[A-Z]$<br>SWE: ^(\d{10}\|\d{12})$<br>TUR: ^\d{11}$<br>ZAF: ^\d{13}$|

|issuingState|string|false|none|Issuing state of the ID document.|

|legalResidenceCountry|string|false|none|none|
|legalResidenceState|string|false|none|none|
|educationalQualification|string|false|none|none|
|fathersName|string|false|none|none|
|greenCard|boolean|false|none|none|
|panNumber|string|false|none|India PanCard, required for India Residents and citizens.|

Instruction result carrying error details for a rejected instruction.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|clientInstructionId|number|true|none|Client-assigned identifier for this instruction; must be a positive number and unique within the request.|
|instructionType|string|true|none|Type of the instruction.|
|instructionStatus|string|true|none|Processing state of the instruction.|
|instructionId|number|true|none|Funds and Banking identifier of the instruction.|
|ibReferenceId|number|false|none|Interactive Brokers global identifier of the request.|
|description|string|false|none|Human-readable note about the result (e.g. polling guidance).|
|processedTimestamp|string(date-time)|false|none|Timestamp at which the instruction was processed.|
|details|[OpenBankingInstructionResultDetails](#schemaopenbankinginstructionresultdetails) \| [WithdrawalInstructionResultDetails](#schemawithdrawalinstructionresultdetails)|false|none|Present only for OPEN_BANKING_INSTRUCTION and WITHDRAWAL_INSTRUCTION instruction types.|
|depositDetails|object|false|none|Present only for the DEPOSIT instruction type.|
|error|object|true|none|Error details returned when the instruction is rejected.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|instructionType|ACH_INSTRUCTION|
|instructionType|CANCEL_INSTRUCTION|

### Properties

|description|string|false|none|Human-readable note about the result (e.g. polling guidance).|

|details|[OpenBankingInstructionResultDetails](#schemaopenbankinginstructionresultdetails) \| [WithdrawalInstructionResultDetails](#schemawithdrawalinstructionresultdetails)|false|none|Present only for OPEN_BANKING_INSTRUCTION and WITHDRAWAL_INSTRUCTION instruction types.|

<h2 id="tocS_ResidenceAddress">ResidenceAddress</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaresidenceaddress"></a>
<a id="schema_ResidenceAddress"></a>
<a id="tocSresidenceaddress"></a>
<a id="tocsresidenceaddress"></a>

```json
{
  "street1": "1 Tester Street",
  "street2": "string",
  "city": "London",
  "state": "GB-ENG",
  "country": "GBR",
  "postalCode": "SW10 9QL"
}
```

Provide the residential address where the applicant physically resides. <br><ul><li>If the mailing address is different from the address provided in Residence element, THEN you will also include MailingAddress element.</li><li>Post Office Box is not accepted for Residential Address.</li><li>Our system validates street_1 and street_2 included within Residence attribute to ensure Post Office Box address is not provided.</li><li>An error will be thrown if the below combinations are included within street_1 OR street_2:</li><ul><li>PB</li><li>PO Box</li><li>Post Office Box</li><li>P.O. Box</li><li>In care of</li><li>General Delivery</li><li>Regular Expression to validate street_1 and street_2:</li></ul></ul>English: (?:P(?:ost(?:al)?)?[\.\-\s]*(?:(?:O(?:ffice)?[\.\s]*)?B(?:ox|in|\b|\d)|o(?:ffice|\b)(?:[-\s]*\d)|code)|box[-\s]*\d)<br>Chinese Simplified: PO Box    (?i)\b((邮政信箱) [0-9]*)\bChinese Traditional: PO Box   (?i)\b((郵政信箱) [0-9]*)\b

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|street1|string|false|none|Street which applicant resides|
|street2|string|false|none|Street which applicant resides|
|city|string|false|none|City which the applicant resides.|
|state|string|false|none|State/Province which the applicant resides.|
|country|string|false|none|Country which the applicant resides.|
|postalCode|string|false|none|Postal / Zip code.For countries that do not provide postal code, please enter 00000|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|string|true|none|Always `ok` on success.|

|scope|string|true|none|The restriction's scope. One of: `Active For Family`, `Active Except`, `Active For Some`, `Inactive`.|
|accountIds|[string \| null]|false|none|Account IDs relevant to the scope. Omitted entirely for `Active For Family` (all accounts are implicitly in scope) and `Inactive` (no accounts). For `Active For Some`, the directly associated accounts, capped at a configurable limit (see `truncated`). For `Active Except`, the excluded accounts, always returned in full and never capped.|
|truncated|boolean \| null|false|none|Present only for `Active For Some`. `true` if the account list was capped at the configured limit and more accounts exist beyond it; `false` if the full list was returned. Never present for other scopes (`Active Except` is always returned in full, uncapped).|

<h2 id="tocS_TraditionalBankInstructionVerification">TraditionalBankInstructionVerification</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schematraditionalbankinstructionverification"></a>
<a id="schema_TraditionalBankInstructionVerification"></a>
<a id="tocStraditionalbankinstructionverification"></a>
<a id="tocstraditionalbankinstructionverification"></a>

```json
{
  "clientInstructionId": 1012983,
  "bankInstructionCode": "ACHUS",
  "bankInstructionName": "TestInstr",
  "accountId": "U453454",
  "pendingInstructionId": 35354345,
  "creditAmount1": 1,
  "creditAmount2": 2
}
```

Request to verify a pending bank instruction using micro-deposit amounts.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|clientInstructionId|number|true|none|Client-assigned identifier for this instruction; must be a positive number and unique within the request.|
|bankInstructionCode|string|true|none|Code identifying the type of bank instruction.|
|bankInstructionName|string|true|none|Name identifying the saved bank instruction / destination.|
|accountId|string|true|none|Interactive Brokers account identifier the instruction applies to (e.g. "U46377").|
|pendingInstructionId|number|true|none|Funds and Banking identifier of the pending instruction being verified.|
|creditAmount1|number|true|none|First micro-deposit amount used to verify the bank instruction; Order is not important.|
|creditAmount2|number|true|none|Second micro-deposit amount used to verify the bank instruction; Order is not important.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|bankInstructionCode|USACH|
|bankInstructionCode|CAACH|
|bankInstructionCode|ACHUS|
|bankInstructionCode|WIRE|

```json
"N"
```

Interactive Brokers supports two forms of allocation methods. Allocation methods that have calculations completed by Interactive Brokers, and a set of allocation methods calculated by the user and then specified. IB-computed allocation methods:
  * `A` - Available Equity
  * `E` - Equal
  * `N` - Net Liquidation Value

User-specified allocation methods:
  * `C` - Cash Quantity
  * `P` - Percentage
  * `R` - Ratios
  * `S` - Shares

Object containing the requested historical data and related metadata.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|serverId|string|false|none|Internal use. Identifier of the request.|
|symbol|string|false|none|Symbol of the request instrument.|
|text|string|false|none|Description or company name of the instrument.|
|priceFactor|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal use. Used to scale Client Portal chart Y-axis.|
|startTime|string|false|none|UTC date and time of the start (chronologically earlier) of the complete period in format YYYYMMDD-hh:mm:ss.|
|high|string|false|none|Internal use. Delivers highest price value in total interval. Used for chart scaling. A string constructed as 'highestPrice*priceFactor/totalVolume*volumeFactor/minutesFromStartTime'.|
|low|string|false|none|Internal use. Delivers lowest price value in total interval. Used for chart scaling. A string constructed as 'lowestPrice*priceFactor/totalVolume*volumeFactor/minutesFromStartTime'.|
|timePeriod|string|false|none|The client-specified period value.|
|barLength|integer(int64)|false|none|The client-specified bar width, represented in seconds.|
|mdAvailability|string|false|none|A three-character string reflecting the nature of available data. R = Realtime, D = Delayed, Z = Frozen, Y = Frozen Delayed, N = Not Subscribed. P = Snapshot, p = Consolidated. B = Top of book.|
|outsideRth|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether data from outside regular trading hours is included in the response.|
|tradingDayDuration|integer(int64)|false|none|Length of instrument's trading day in seconds.|
|volumeFactor|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal use. Used to scale volume histograms.|
|priceDisplayRule|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal use. Governs application of pricing display rule.|
|priceDisplayValue|string|false|none|Internal use. Governs rendering of displayed pricing.|
|chartPanStartTime|string|false|none|Internal use. UTC datetime string used to center Client Portal charts. Format YYYYMMDD-hh:mm:ss.|
|direction|integer(int64)|false|none|Indicates how the period is applied in relation to the startTime. Value will always be -1, indicating that the period extends from the startTime forward into the future.|
|negativeCapable|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether instrument is capable of negative pricing.|
|messageVersion|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal use. Reflects the version of the response schema used.|
|travelTime|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal time in flight to serve the request.|
|data|[[singleHistoricalBarBidAsk](#schemasinglehistoricalbarbidask)]|false|none|Array containing OHLC bars for the requested period.|
|points|integer(int64)|false|none|Count of the number of bars returned in the data array.|
|mktDataDelay|integer(int64)|false|none|Number of milliseconds taken to satisfy this historical data request.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|-1|

```json
  "points": 0,
  "mktDataDelay": 0
}
```

Object containing the requested historical data and related metadata.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|serverId|string|false|none|Internal use. Identifier of the request.|
|symbol|string|false|none|Symbol of the request instrument.|
|text|string|false|none|Description or company name of the instrument.|
|priceFactor|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal use. Used to scale Client Portal chart Y-axis.|
|startTime|string|false|none|UTC date and time of the start (chronologically earlier) of the complete period in format YYYYMMDD-hh:mm:ss.|
|high|string|false|none|Internal use. Delivers highest price value in total interval. Used for chart scaling. A string constructed as 'highestPrice*priceFactor/totalVolume*volumeFactor/minutesFromStartTime'.|
|low|string|false|none|Internal use. Delivers lowest price value in total interval. Used for chart scaling. A string constructed as 'lowestPrice*priceFactor/totalVolume*volumeFactor/minutesFromStartTime'.|
|timePeriod|string|false|none|The client-specified period value.|
|barLength|integer(int64)|false|none|The client-specified bar width, represented in seconds.|
|mdAvailability|string|false|none|A three-character string reflecting the nature of available data. R = Realtime, D = Delayed, Z = Frozen, Y = Frozen Delayed, N = Not Subscribed. P = Snapshot, p = Consolidated. B = Top of book.|
|outsideRth|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether data from outside regular trading hours is included in the response.|
|tradingDayDuration|integer(int64)|false|none|Length of instrument's trading day in seconds.|
|volumeFactor|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal use. Used to scale volume histograms.|
|priceDisplayRule|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal use. Governs application of pricing display rule.|
|priceDisplayValue|string|false|none|Internal use. Governs rendering of displayed pricing.|
|chartPanStartTime|string|false|none|Internal use. UTC datetime string used to center Client Portal charts. Format YYYYMMDD-hh:mm:ss.|
|direction|integer(int64)|false|none|Indicates how the period is applied in relation to the startTime. Value will always be -1, indicating that the period extends from the startTime forward into the future.|
|negativeCapable|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether instrument is capable of negative pricing.|
|messageVersion|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal use. Reflects the version of the response schema used.|
|travelTime|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal time in flight to serve the request.|
|data|[[singleHistoricalBarMidpoint](#schemasinglehistoricalbarmidpoint)]|false|none|Array containing OHLC bars for the requested period.|
|points|integer(int64)|false|none|Count of the number of bars returned in the data array.|
|mktDataDelay|integer(int64)|false|none|Number of milliseconds taken to satisfy this historical data request.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|direction|-1|

<h2 id="tocS_mdFields">mdFields</h2>


Market Data fields enumerating tick ids to their respective value. May provide a comma-separated series of fields. A maximum of 50 fields may be specified at one time.
  * `31` - Last Price. The last price at which the contract traded. May contain one of the following prefixes: C - Previous day's closing price. H - Trading has halted.
  * `55` - Symbol. 
  * `58` - Text. 
  * `70` - High. Current day high price
  * `71` - Low. Current day low price
  * `73` - Market Value. The current market value of your position in the security. Market Value is calculated with real time market data (even when not subscribed to market data).
  * `74` - Avg Price. The average price of the position.
  * `75` - Unrealized PnL. Unrealized profit or loss. Unrealized PnL is calculated with real time market data (even when not subscribed to market data).
  * `76` - Formatted position. 
  * `77` - Formatted Unrealized PnL. 
  * `78` - Daily PnL. Your profit or loss of the day since prior close. Daily PnL is calculated with real time market data (even when not subscribed to market data).
  * `79` - Realized PnL. Realized profit or loss. Realized PnL is calculated with real time market data (even when not subscribed to market data).
  * `80` - Unrealized PnL %. Unrealized profit or loss expressed in percentage.
  * `82` - Change. The difference between the last price and the close on the previous trading day
  * `83` - Change %. The difference between the last price and the close on the previous trading day in percentage.
  * `84` - Bid Price. The highest-priced bid on the contract.
  * `85` - Ask Size. The number of contracts or shares offered at the ask price. For US stocks
  * `86` - Ask Price. The lowest-priced offer on the contract.
  * `87` - Volume. Volume for the day
  * `88` - Bid Size. The number of contracts or shares bid for at the bid price. For US stocks
  * `201` - Right. Declares the Right of the Option, Call or Put.
  * `6004` - Exchange. 
  * `6008` - Conid. Contract identifier from IBKR's database.
  * `6070` - SecType. The asset class of the instrument.
  * `6072` - Months. 
  * `6073` - Regular Expiry. 
  * `6119` - Marker for market data delivery method (similar to request id). 
  * `6457` - Underlying Conid. Use /trsrv/secdef to get more information about the security. 
  * `6508` - Service Params.. 
  * `6509` - Market Data Availability. The field may contain three chars. First char defines: R = RealTime, D = Delayed, Z = Frozen, Y = Frozen Delayed, N = Not Subscribed, i - incomplete, v - VDR Exempt (Vendor Display Rule 603c). Second char defines: P = Snapshot, p = Consolidated. Third char defines: B = Book. RealTime Data is relayed back in real time without delay, market data subscription(s) are required. Delayed - Data is relayed back 15-20 min delayed. Frozen - Last recorded data at market close.  relayed back in real time. Frozen Delayed - Last recorded data at market close, relayed back delayed. Not Subscribed - User does not have the required market data subscription(s) to relay back either real time or delayed data. Snapshot - Snapshot request is available for contract. Consolidated - Market data is aggregated across multiple exchanges or venues. Book - Top of the book data is available for contract.
  * `7051` - Company name. 
  * `7057` - Ask Exch. Displays the exchange(s) offering the SMART price. A=AMEX, C=CBOE, I=ISE, X=PHLX, N=PSE, B=BOX, Q=NASDAQOM, Z=BATS, W=CBOE2, T=NASDAQBX, M=MIAX, H=GEMINI, E=EDGX, J=MERCURY
  * `7058` - Last Exch. Displays the exchange(s) offering the SMART price. A=AMEX, C=CBOE, I=ISE, X=PHLX, N=PSE, B=BOX, Q=NASDAQOM, Z=BATS, W=CBOE2, T=NASDAQBX, M=MIAX, H=GEMINI, E=EDGX, J=MERCURY
  * `7059` - Last Size. The number of unites traded at the last price
  * `7068` - Bid Exch. Displays the exchange(s) offering the SMART price. A=AMEX, C=CBOE, I=ISE, X=PHLX, N=PSE, B=BOX, Q=NASDAQOM, Z=BATS, W=CBOE2, T=NASDAQBX, M=MIAX, H=GEMINI, E=EDGX, J=MERCURY
  * `7084` - Implied Vol./Hist. Vol %. The ratio of the implied volatility over the historical volatility, expressed as a percentage.
  * `7085` - Total Put option open interest divided by the Call option open interest for the trading day. May only be used on underlyings.
  * `7086` - Put/Call Volume. Put option volume/call option volume for the trading day.
  * `7087` - Hist. Vol. %. 30-day real-time historical volatility.
  * `7088` - Hist. Vol. Close %. Shows the historical volatility based on previous close price.
  * `7089` - Opt. Volume. Option Volume
  * `7094` - Conid + Exchange.
  * `7184` - canBeTraded. If contract is a trade-able instrument. Returns 1(true) or 0(false).
  * `7219` - Contract Description.
  * `7220` - Contract Description.
  * `7221` - Listing Exchange.
  * `7280` - Industry. Displays the type of industry under which the underlying company can be categorized.
  * `7281` - Category. Displays a more detailed level of description within the industry under which the underlying company can be categorized.
  * `7282` - Average Volume. The average daily trading volume over 90 days.
  * `7283` - Option Implied Vol. %. A prediction of how volatile an underlying will be in the future.At the market volatility estimated for a maturity thirty calendar days forward of the current trading day, and based on option prices from two consecutive expiration months. To query the Implied Vol. % of a specific strike refer to field 7633.
  * `7284` - Historical volatility %. Deprecated
  * `7285` - Put/Call Ratio.
  * `7292` - Cost Basis. Your current position in this security multiplied by the average price and multiplier.        
  * `7293` - 52 Week High. The highest price for the past 52 weeks.
  * `7294` - 52 Week Low. The lowest price for the past 52 weeks.
  * `7295` - Open. Today's opening price.
  * `7296` - Close. Today's closing price.
  * `7308` - Delta. The ratio of the change in the price of the option to the corresponding change in the price of the underlying.
  * `7309` - Gamma. The rate of change for the delta with respect to the underlying asset's price.
  * `7310` - Theta. A measure of the rate of decline the value of an option due to the passage of time.
  * `7311` - Vega. The amount that the price of an option changes compared to a 1% change in the volatility.
  * `7607` - Opt. Volume Change %. Today's option volume as a percentage of the average option volume.
  * `7633` - Implied Vol. %. The implied volatility for the specific strike of the option in percentage. To query the Option Implied Vol. % from the underlying refer to field 7283.
  * `7635` - Mark. The mark price is
  * `7636` - Shortable Shares. Number of shares available for shorting.
  * `7637` - Fee Rate. Interest rate charged on borrowed shares.
  * `7638` - Option Open Interest. Available for Underlyings and Derivatives.
  * `7639` - % of Mark Value. Displays the market value of the contract as a percentage of the total market value of the account. Mark Value is calculated with real time market data (even when not subscribed to market data).
  * `7644` - Shortable. Describes the level of difficulty with which the security can be sold short.       
  * `7671` - Dividends. This value is the total of the expected dividend payments over the next twelve months per share.
  * `7672` - Dividends TTM. This value is the total of the expected dividend payments over the last twelve months per share.
  * `7674` - EMA(200). Exponential moving average (N=200).
  * `7675` - EMA(100). Exponential moving average (N=100).
  * `7676` - EMA(50). Exponential moving average (N=50).
  * `7677` - EMA(20). Exponential moving average (N=20).
  * `7678` - Price/EMA(200). Price to Exponential moving average (N=200) ratio -1
  * `7679` - Price/EMA(100). Price to Exponential moving average (N=100) ratio -1
  * `7724` - Price/EMA(50). Price to Exponential moving average (N=50) ratio -1
  * `7681` - Price/EMA(20). Price to Exponential moving average (N=20) ratio -1
  * `7682` - Change Since Open. The difference between the last price and the open price.
  * `7683` - Upcoming Event. Shows the next major company event. Requires Wall Street Horizon subscription.
  * `7684` - Upcoming Event Date. The date of the next major company event. Requires Wall Street Horizon subscription. 
  * `7685` - Upcoming Analyst Meeting. The date and time of the next scheduled analyst meeting. Requires Wall Street Horizon subscription.
  * `7686` - Upcoming Earnings. The date and time of the next scheduled earnings/earnings call event. Requires Wall Street Horizon subscription.
  * `7687` - Upcoming Misc Event. The date and time of the next shareholder meeting
  * `7688` - Recent Analyst Meeting. The date and time of the most recent analyst meeting. Requires Wall Street Horizon subscription.
  * `7689` - Recent Earnings. The date and time of the most recent earnings/earning call event. Requires Wall Street Horizon subscription.
  * `7690` - Recent Misc Event. The date and time of the most recent shareholder meeting
  * `7694` - Probability of Max Return. Customer implied probability of maximum potential gain.
  * `7695` - Break Even. Break even points
  * `7696` - SPX Delta. Beta Weighted Delta is calculated using the formula; Delta x dollar adjusted beta
  * `7697` - Futures Open Interest. Total number of outstanding futures contracts
  * `7698` - Last Yield. Implied yield of the bond if it is purchased at the current last price. Last yield is calculated using the Last price on all possible call dates. It is assumed that prepayment occurs if the bond has call or put provisions and the issuer can offer a lower coupon rate based on current market rates. The yield to worst will be the lowest of the yield to maturity or yield to call (if the bond has prepayment provisions). Yield to worse may be the same as yield to maturity but never higher.
  * `7699` - Bid Yield. Implied yield of the bond if it is purchased at the current bid price. Bid yield is calculated using the Ask on all possible call dates. It is assumed that prepayment occurs if the bond has call or put provisions and the issuer can offer a lower coupon rate based on current market rates. The yield to worst will be the lowest of the yield to maturity or yield to call (if the bond has prepayment provisions). Yield to worse may be the same as yield to maturity but never higher.
  * `7700` - Probability of Max Return. Customer implied probability of maximum potential gain.
  * `7702` - Probability of Max Loss. Customer implied probability of maximum potential loss.
  * `7703` - Profit Probability. Customer implied probability of any gain.
  * `7704` - Organization Type.
  * `7705` - Debt Class.
  * `7706` - Ratings. Ratings issued for bond contract.
  * `7707` - Bond State Code.
  * `7708` - Bond Type.
  * `7714` - Last Trading Date.
  * `7715` - Issue Date.
  * `7720` - Ask Yield. Implied yield of the bond if it is purchased at the current offer. Ask yield is calculated using the Bid on all possible call dates. It is assumed that prepayment occurs if the bond has call or put provisions and the issuer can offer a lower coupon rate based on current market rates. The yield to worst will be the lowest of the yield to maturity or yield to call (if the bond has prepayment provisions). Yield to worse may be the same as yield to maturity but never higher.
  * `7741` - Prior Close. Yesterday's closing price
  * `7762` - Volume Long. High precision volume for the day. For formatted volume refer to field 87.
  * `7768` - hasTradingPermissions. if user has trading permissions for specified contract. Returns 1(true) or 0(false).
  * `7899` - Stock Type. Determines the stock type. Includes: Common, CORP, ADR, ETF, ETN, EFN, REIT, CEF, ETMF.
  * `7920` - Daily PnL Raw. Your profit or loss of the day since prior close. Daily PnL is calculated with real-time market data (even when not subscribed to market data).
  * `7921` - Cost Basis Raw. Your current position in this security multiplied by the average price and and multiplier.
  * `7943` - Rebate Rate. Fed funds or other currency-relevant Benchmark rate minus the interest rate charged on borrowed shares.

Object containing information about the status of an order ticket.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sub_type|string \| null|false|none|Internal use only.|
|request_id|string|false|none|Internal use only. IB-assigned identifier for the status request.|
|server_id|string|false|none|IB-assigned meta-identifier used to associate rejected and resubmitted orders following Server Prompts.|
|order_id|integer(int64)|false|none|The IB-assigned order identifier of the order, as provided in the request path.|
|conidex|string|false|none|Contract ID and routing destination in format 123456@EXCHANGE.|
|conid|integer(int64)|false|none|Contract ID of the order's instrument.|
|symbol|string|false|none|Symbol of the order ticket's instrument.|
|side|string|false|none|Side of the order ticket.|
|contract_description_1|string|false|none|Human-readable description of the order's instrument.|
|listing_exchange|string|false|none|Primary listing exchange of the order ticket's instrument.|
|option_acct|string|false|none|Internal use only.|
|company_name|string|false|none|Name of the company or asset associated with the instrument.|
|size|string|false|none|Remaining unfilled size of the order ticket. Will reflect 0.0 if order is filled in full, cancelled, or otherwise resolved and no longer working.|
|total_size|string|false|none|The total size of the order ticket.|
|currency|string|false|none|The currency in which the instrument trades and executions are conducted.|
|account|string|false|none|The account receiving executions against this order ticket.|
|order_type|string|false|none|The order's  IB order type.|
|cum_fill|string|false|none|Cumulative filled quantity of the instrument against the order ticket.|
|order_status|string|false|none|Status of the order ticket.|
|order_ccp_status|string|false|none|IB internal order status.|
|order_status_description|string|false|none|Human-readable rendering of the order's status meant for presentation in UI.|
|tif|string|false|none|Time in force of the order ticket.|
|fgColor|string|false|none|Internal use. IB's UI foreground color in hex.|
|bgColor|string|false|none|Internal use. IB's UI background color in hex.|
|order_not_editable|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the order ticket can be modified.|
|editable_fields|string|false|none|Indicates which fields of the order ticket can be modified currently.|
|cannot_cancel_order|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the order ticket can be cancelled.|
|deactivate_order|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the order ticket can be deactivated.|
|sec_type|string|false|none|IB asset class identifier.|
|available_chart_periods|string|false|none|Internal use. Indicates chart periods available for the instrument.|
|order_description|string|false|none|Human-readable description of the status or current result of the order ticket, meant for UI presentation.|
|order_description_with_contract|string|false|none|Human-readable description of the status or current result of the order ticket, meant for UI presentation. Includes instrument name.|
|alert_active|integer(int64)|false|none|Indicates that an alert is active for the order ticket.|
|child_order_type|string|false|none|Indicates if the order ticket is hedged, and if so, in what way. 0 = No hedge, A = Attached child hedge order, B = Beta/portfolio hedge|
|order_clearing_account|string|false|none|The IB account to which the order ticket clears.|
|size_and_fills|string|false|none|A string reflecting the cumulative fills and total size of the order.|
|exit_strategy_display_price|string|false|none|Internal use. The UI-displayed price associated with a Client Portal exist strategy.|
|exit_strategy_chart_description|string|false|none|Internal use. A string describing an active Client Portal exit strategy, or the result of its execution.|
|average_price|string|false|none|Average price of fills against the order, if any.|
|exit_strategy_tool_availability|string|false|none|Internal use. Indicates the availability of Client Portal exit strategy tool for the order.|
|allowed_duplicate_opposite|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether an identical order on the opposite side can be placed.|
|order_time|string|false|none|Time of the order's submission in format YYMMDDhhmmss.|

Envelope returned by the polling-style rebalance endpoints (`/fa/model/rebalance/to-existing-targets` and `/fa/model/rebalance/to-new-targets`). Callers should re-issue the request supplying the returned `subscriptionKey` until `subscriptionStatus` transitions out of the pending state.

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|reqID|string|false|none|Request identifier echoed from the originating request.|
|subscriptionKey|string|false|none|Subscription key to include on follow-up poll requests.|
|subscriptionStatus|integer(int64)|false|none|Polling state indicator.<br> * `0` - Result is still being computed; continue polling.<br> * `1` - Result is ready.<br>|

<a id="schemasinglewatchlist"></a>
<a id="schema_singleWatchlist"></a>
<a id="tocSsinglewatchlist"></a>
<a id="tocssinglewatchlist"></a>

```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "hash": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "readOnly": true,
  "instruments": [
    {
      "ST": "STK",
      "C": "string",
      "conid": 0,
      "name": "string",
      "fullName": "string",
      "assetClass": "STK",
      "ticker": "string",
      "chineseName": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

Object detailing a single watchlist.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|Identifier of the watchlist.|
|hash|string|false|none|Internal use. Unique hash of the watchlist.|
|name|string|false|none|Human-readable display name of the watchlist.|
|readOnly|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the watchlist can be edited.|
|instruments|[[singleWatchlistEntry](#schemasinglewatchlistentry)]|false|none|Array of instruments contained in the watchlist.|

<h2 id="tocS_singleWatchlistEntry">singleWatchlistEntry</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemasinglewatchlistentry"></a>
<a id="schema_singleWatchlistEntry"></a>
<a id="tocSsinglewatchlistentry"></a>
<a id="tocssinglewatchlistentry"></a>

```json
{
  "ST": "STK",
  "C": "string",
  "conid": 0,
  "name": "string",
  "fullName": "string",
  "assetClass": "STK",
  "ticker": "string",
  "chineseName": "string"
}
```

Object containing watchlist entry for a single instrument.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ST|string|false|none|All-capital, shorthand security type identifier of the instrument.|
|C|string|false|none|Instrument conid as a string.|
|conid|integer(int64)|false|none|IB contract ID of the instrument.|
|name|string|false|none|Complete display name of the instrument.|
|fullName|string|false|none|Full display presentation of the instrument symbol.|
|assetClass|string|false|none|All-capital, shorthand security type identifier of the instrument.|
|ticker|string|false|none|Symbol of the instrument.|
|chineseName|string|false|none|Rendering of the instrument name in Chinese.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|ST|STK|
|ST|OPT|
|ST|FUT|
|ST|BOND|
|ST|FUND|
|ST|WAR|
|ST|CASH|
|ST|CRYPTO|
|assetClass|STK|
|assetClass|OPT|
|assetClass|FUT|
|assetClass|BOND|
|assetClass|FUND|
|assetClass|WAR|
|assetClass|CASH|
|assetClass|CRYPTO|

<h2 id="tocS_ssoValidateResponse">ssoValidateResponse</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemassovalidateresponse"></a>
<a id="schema_ssoValidateResponse"></a>
<a id="tocSssovalidateresponse"></a>
<a id="tocsssovalidateresponse"></a>

```json
{
  "USER_ID": 0,
  "USER_NAME": "string",
  "RESULT": true,
  "AUTH_TIME": 0,
  "SF_ENABLED": true,
  "IS_FREE_TRIAL": true,
  "CREDENTIAL": "string",
  "IP": "string",
  "EXPIRES": 0,
  "QUALIFIED_FOR_MOBILE_AUTH": true,
  "LANDING_APP": "string",
  "IS_MASTER": true,
  "lastAccessed": 0,
  "loginType": 0,
  "PAPER_USER_NAME": "string",
  "features": {
    "envs": "string",
    "wlms": true,
    "realtime": true,
    "bond": true,
    "optionChains": true,
    "calendar": true,
    "newMf": true
  },
  "region": "string"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|USER_ID|integer(int64)|false|none|Internal user identifier.|
|USER_NAME|string|false|none|current username logged in for the session.|
|RESULT|boolean|false|none|Confirms if validation was successful. True if session was validated; false if not.|
|AUTH_TIME|integer(int64)|false|none|Returns the time of authentication in epoch time.|
|SF_ENABLED|boolean|false|none|(Internal use only)|
|IS_FREE_TRIAL|boolean|false|none|Returns if the account is a trial account or a funded account.|
|CREDENTIAL|string|false|none|Returns the underlying username of the account.|
|IP|string|false|none|Internal use only. Does not reflect the IP address of the user.|
|EXPIRES|integer(int64)|false|none|Returns the time until SSO session expiration in milliseconds.|
|QUALIFIED_FOR_MOBILE_AUTH|boolean|false|none|Returns if the customer requires two factor authentication.|
|LANDING_APP|string|false|none|Used for Client Portal (Internal use only)|
|IS_MASTER|boolean|false|none|Returns whether the account is a master account (true) or subaccount (false).|
|lastAccessed|integer(int64)|false|none|Returns the last time the user was accessed in epoch time.|
|loginType|integer(int64)|false|none|Returns the login type. 1 for Live, 2 for Paper|
|PAPER_USER_NAME|string|false|none|Returns the paper username for the account.|
|features|object|false|none|Returns supported features such as bonds and option trading.|
|region|string|false|none|Returns the region connected to internally.|

```json
{
  "account": "string",
  "batchNumber": 0,
  "cashQty": "string",
  "closePosition": true,
  "conid": 0,
  "isCashQty": true,
  "model": "string",
```

Allocation instruction produced by the TWS invest/divest planner.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account|string|false|none|Account the allocation applies to.|
|batchNumber|integer(int64)|false|none|Batch grouping used to order the submitted transfers.|
|cashQty|string|false|none|Cash-denominated quantity for the allocation.|
|closePosition|boolean|false|none|True if this allocation fully closes the position.|
|conid|integer(int64)|false|none|Contract identifier for the instrument being allocated.|
|isCashQty|boolean|false|none|True if the allocation is expressed as a cash amount rather than a share quantity.|
|model|string|false|none|Destination model for the allocation.|
|price|string|false|none|Price used to compute the allocation.|
|quantity|string|false|none|Share quantity for the allocation.|
|relatedRequestAccount|string|false|none|Account associated with the related upstream request.|
|relatedRequestID|string|false|none|Identifier of the related upstream request that produced this allocation.|
|secType|string|false|none|Security type (e.g. `STK`).|

Cash transfer between a source and destination model produced by the TWS invest/divest planner.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account|string|false|none|Account the cash transfer applies to.|
|amt|string|false|none|Amount of cash to transfer, expressed in `ccy`.|
|batchNumber|integer(int64)|false|none|Batch grouping used to order the submitted transfers.|
|ccy|string|false|none|Currency of the cash transfer (ISO 4217).|
|destinationModel|string|false|none|Model receiving the cash.|
|sourceModel|string|false|none|Model supplying the cash (e.g. `Core` for the independent cash pool).|

Response envelope returned by `/fa/model/tws-invest-divest`, containing the computed allocation plan, cash transfers between models, and any errors or pending position transfers.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allocations|[[twsInvestDivestAllocation](#schematwsinvestdivestallocation)]|false|none|Per-instrument allocation instructions produced by the invest/divest planner.|
|cashTransfers|[[twsInvestDivestCashTransfer](#schematwsinvestdivestcashtransfer)]|false|none|Cash movements between source and destination models required to fund the plan.|
|errors|[string]|false|none|Errors produced by the planner. `null` when the plan is successful.|
|positionTransfers|[object]|false|none|Position transfers scheduled between the source and destination models.|
|reqID|integer(int64)|false|none|Request identifier echoed from the originating request.|
|subscriptionStatus|integer(int64)|false|none|Describes if the model is in polling mode.|
|transfersInstructionId|integer(int64)|false|none|Identifier that groups the resulting transfers; supply to downstream submit endpoints.|

<h2 id="tocS_typecodes">typecodes</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schematypecodes"></a>
<a id="schema_typecodes"></a>
<a id="tocStypecodes"></a>
<a id="tocstypecodes"></a>

```json
"BA"
```

Many FYI endpoints reference a "typecode" value. The table below lists the available codes and what they correspond to.
  * `BA` - Borrow Availability
  * `CA` - Comparable Algo
  * `DA` - Dividends Advisory
  * `EA` - Upcoming Earnings
  * `MF` - Mutual Fund Advisory
  * `OE` - Option Expiration
  * `PR` - Portfolio Builder Rebalance
  * `SE` - Suspend Order on Economic Event
  * `SG` - Short Term Gain turning Long Term
  * `SM` - System Messages
  * `T2` - Assignment Realizing Long-Term Gains
  * `TO` - Takeover
  * `UA` - User Alert
  * `M8` - M871 Trades
  * `PS` - Platform Use Suggestions
  * `DL` - Unexercised Option Loss Prevention Reminder
  * `PT` - Position Transfer
  * `CB` - Missing Cost Basis
  * `MS` - Milestones
  * `TD` - MiFID || 10% Deprecation Notice
  * `ST` - Save Taxes
  * `TI` - Trade Idea
  * `CT` - Cash Transfer
